issues.description: In the template, the quantity getter in StockIngredient is named retrieveQuantity(), while other code and the problem statement expect a standard getter getQuantity(). Stock.java (and Main.java in the template) call getQuantity(), and the problem explicitly asks to add getters for all private fields. The solution uses getQuantity(). This identifier mismatch will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the expected getter name.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename or add the getter in the template StockIngredient from retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), matching the usage in Stock.java and the requirement in the problem statement. Alternatively, update Stock.java and other callers to use retrieveQuantity(), but the preferred fix is to provide a standard getQuantity() method to align with the problem statement and the solution.
